name: Big Picture Foods
old_description: Free Shipping on orders over $75. All packages ship on Monday & Tuesday.
about:
Big Picture Foods operates from Barrington, Rhode Island, producing a line of artisan specialty foods centered on regeneratively farmed organic olives. The company emphasizes small-batch craft production, with olives that are sun-ripened and hand-picked at peak perfection before undergoing a natural fermentation process.

The product range includes several olive varieties—such as Greek Mix, Green Amfissa, and Double Stuffed Garlic & Jalapeño—alongside wild foraged capers, extra virgin olive oil, and jarred banana and red peppers. All items are slow-cured using natural fermentation, which the company says preserves nutrients and yields gut-friendly probiotics. Every product contains only four ingredients and no additives or preservatives.

Big Picture Foods sells through a growing network of retail partners across the United States, directing consumers to a store locator on its website. The brand targets shoppers seeking raw, antioxidant-rich pantry staples that support digestive health and anti-inflammatory benefits, positioning itself as an alternative to chemically cured, mass-produced equivalents.

The company frames its mission around regenerative agriculture, stating that its groves withdrew 20 tons of carbon from the atmosphere last year compared with seven tons added by conventional methods. It describes this climate impact as core to its "different bottom line," linking soil health directly to the flavor and nutritional profile of its fermented foods.
